judged_text: In credential-sync mode refreshOAuthTokens returns a fetch Response, but the next statement reads zohoCrmTokenInfo.data — the axios response shape — which is undefined on a fetch Response, so !zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error throws TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'error'). Zoho CRM token refresh crashes on every attempt when sync is enabled; the credential is never refreshed and the Zoho CRM integration fails for sync-enabled hosts.

record.issue_text: [BUG] In credential-sync mode refreshOAuthTokens returns a fetch Response, but the next statement reads zohoCrmTokenInfo.data — the axios response shape — which is undefined on a fetch Response, so !zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error throws TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'error'). Zoho CRM token refresh crashes on every attempt when sync is enabled; the credential is never refreshed and the Zoho CRM integration fails for sync-enabled hosts.

adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `refreshOAuthTokens`, which, when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` and `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` are set and a `userId` is provided, returns a `fetch(...)` Response object (see `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`). In `packages/app-store/zohocrm/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the code assigns `const zohoCrmTokenInfo = await refreshOAuthTokens(...)` and then immediately reads `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error`. A `fetch` Response does not have a `.data` property (that’s an axios shape), so in sync mode `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data` is `undefined` and `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error` will throw a TypeError. This matches the reported crash path.
